Form replay replay one critical turn (lean, gaze, hand) or a whole segment end to end
Left: you from behind, leaning as you leaned. Right: the same turn from above on the real map, rotated so you are always heading up. The Most scrubbed chips jump to the turns where you bled the most speed.
Every part of the pictureOn the left, the ghost needle marks this turn's peak lean, and the arc and tint go grey (approach), green (cornering), amber (exit). When AirPods are clean, the gaze needle shows where you are looking relative to where you are heading (green = into the corner). On the right, heading-up means a left turn bends left here too, matching the figure on the left, while the ground stays recognizable; the marker advances along the track in step with the replay, and the small compass shows where north ended up.

Phone in hand detected. Arm-swing energy at half cadence dominates the horizontal accel. Cadence and pace are reliable; vertical oscillation may be inflated by hand motion (treat it as an upper bound). For cleanest form metrics, switch to a hip pack or armband on your next run.

Cadence vs motor power e-bike pedaling efficiency · each point a FIT sample, coloured by grade
Spin with the motor (cadence ~70-95 rpm) and it delivers power efficiently; grinding a low cadence under heavy assist (bottom-left of the climb cluster) lugs the motor and tires your legs. Red points are climbs, blue descents.

Climbs & balance per-climb power, cadence, and pacing (grade > 3% sustained) · left/right power balance
#TimeGradeVAMAvg WNPCadHR driftFade
VAM is vertical metres climbed per hour. Fade is last-third vs first-third power on the climb: strongly negative means you started too hard.
Descents & corners corners marked on the map (tap a chip to jump to one) · repeated descents grouped as laps (A·1, A·2) · radius r = v/ω at the apex
#LapTimeDistDropGradeMax speedCornersTightestApex speed
Corner radius and apex speed come from 1 Hz GPS geometry, solid for road sweepers, approximate for tight hairpins. Repeat the same descent and compare apex speeds to track cornering confidence.

AI Coach your metrics, turned into coaching — sent to Anthropic only when you ask
Sends this session's metrics (not raw sensor data), plus a summary of your Apple Health vitals and recent Strava activity when those are connected, to Anthropic and streams back a coaching insight. Roughly $0.02-0.10 per insight, billed to your key.
